column1: # Where every file in ref/ comes from. Checked by `python -m utils.verify_refs`
# (offline, in CI and tests/test_reference_sources.py): every file in ref/ is
# listed, and each pinned file still has the SHA-256 below. A pinned file changes
# only through its fetch or build step, followed by
# in the same commit. Curated files are edited by hand or by review_helper and are
# not pinned: git records every change to them.
# kind: fetched (downloaded as is), built (by the script named in source),
#       supplied (handed over by a person), curated (maintained in this repo).
# retrieved: when the pinned content was obtained; for files placed before this
#       list existed, the date of the commit that added it.
